items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1959-10-26
items.q: And there was a man who used to teach us there, was named Sokola.

ctx.x: Mr. Marocca, did you ever play, or not play, but sing or have anything to do with the St. Alphonsus choir?

No, I didn't. But I did sing at the closing exercise. And there was a man who used to teach us there, was named Sokola. His first name, I can't remember. But he used to put on the show for us. And we were singing the Holy City. Ta-da, ta-da, ta-da, ta-da, Hosanna, and so on. And I used to sing counter melodies against it. At that time I didn't know anything. I could show you on the piano how easy it is for me to get a melody. And many people say, how you put them together? Well, to me they come just like they…
